summary: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its Annual and Special Shareholders' Meeting held July 30, 2026. All seven director nominees were elected with over 97% votes for each, PwC was appointed as auditors with 99.54% approval, the advisory executive compensation resolution passed at 98.16%, and the amended omnibus incentive plan was approved with 70.04% votes for. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no special-situation transaction, board change, or strategic event. No M&A, tender offer, capital return, or restructuring is announced; the filing merely confirms shareholder votes on standard matters.
